name: Legends of Maraudon
summary: A search for the two pieces of Celebras’s Scepter leads you to seek a way to speak with Celebras.

sections.title: The Scepter Pieces
sections.body: You seek the Celebrian Rod and Celebrian Diamond, the two parts of Celebras’s Scepter. You also need a way to speak with Celebras.

faq.q: What pieces am I looking for?
faq.answer: The Celebrian Rod and Celebrian Diamond are the two parts of Celebras’s Scepter.

faq.q: Who do I need to speak with?
faq.answer: You are looking for a way to speak with Celebras.
The Celebrian Rod is one of the two parts of Celebras’s Scepter.
The Celebrian Diamond is one of the two parts of Celebras’s Scepter.
